six_semantic_rejections:
tactic 'decide' proved that the proposition
  ∀ (e : E),
    e = E.a ∨ e = E.b ∨ e = E.k →
      ∀ (c : C),
        e = E.a ∧ (c = C.cx ∨ c = C.cl) ∨
            e = E.b ∧ c = C.cr ∨ e = E.k ∧ (c = C.cx ∨ c = C.cl ∨ c = C.cr ∨ c = C.cm) ∨ e = E.o ∧ c = C.cz →
          B.h = B.g ∧ (c = C.cx ∨ c = C.cl ∨ c = C.cr ∨ c = C.cm) ∨ True ∧ c = C.cz
is false

tactic 'decide' proved that the proposition
  ∃ c,
    (E.k = E.a ∧ (c = C.cx ∨ c = C.cl) ∨
        E.k = E.b ∧ c = C.cr ∨ True ∧ (c = C.cx ∨ c = C.cl ∨ c = C.cr ∨ c = C.cm) ∨ E.k = E.o ∧ c = C.cz) ∧
      (match c with
        | C.cx => B.x
        | C.cl => B.l
        | C.cr => B.r
        | C.cm => B.m
        | C.cz => B.z) =
        B.h
is false

tactic 'decide' proved that the proposition
  ∃ s,
    ∀ (e : E),
      True →
        ∀ (c : C),
          e = E.a ∧ (c = C.cx ∨ c = C.cl) ∨
              e = E.b ∧ c = C.cr ∨ e = E.k ∧ (c = C.cx ∨ c = C.cl ∨ c = C.cr ∨ c = C.cm) ∨ e = E.o ∧ c = C.cz →
            s = B.g ∧ (c = C.cx ∨ c = C.cl ∨ c = C.cr ∨ c = C.cm) ∨ s = B.h ∧ c = C.cz
is false

tactic 'decide' proved that the proposition
  (W.w2 = W.w0 ∨ W.w2 = W.w1) ∧
    (B.x = B.g ∧
        (Exercise.actX = Exercise.sayG ∨
          Exercise.actX = Exercise.provideA ∨ Exercise.actX = Exercise.provideB ∨ Exercise.actX = Exercise.provideK) ∨
      B.x = B.h ∧ Exercise.actX = Exercise.provideO ∨ True ∧ (Exercise.actX = Exercise.sayX ∨ True))
is false

tactic 'decide' proved that the proposition
  (W.w2 = W.w0 ∨ W.w2 = W.w1) ∧ Content.absent = Content.present ∨ True ∧ True →
    (W.w2 = W.w0 ∨ W.w2 = W.w1) ∧
      (B.x = B.g ∧ Token.v = Token.u ∧ Content.absent = Content.present ∨ True ∧ True ∧ True)
is false

tactic 'decide' proved that the proposition
  True ∧ R.rx = R.rg ∨
    B.g = B.h ∧ R.rx = R.rh ∨
      B.g = B.x ∧ True ∨
        B.g = B.l ∧ R.rx = R.rl ∨ B.g = B.r ∧ R.rx = R.rr ∨ B.g = B.m ∧ R.rx = R.rm ∨ B.g = B.z ∧ R.rx = R.rz
is false
